caption: The drawing depicts a lidded glass stein with a handle. The main stein is rendered in shades of grey and light blue, emphasizing its transparent glass material. It has a rounded body with horizontal bands etched around its circumference at intervals. The lid is domed, featuring a finial at the top shaped in a spiral or twisted design. A curved handle attaches to the upper right side of the stein and is secured at two points on the vessel, with a small curled decorative end at the lower attachment. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, inset black-and-white line sketch of the same stein, showing the same lid, finial, body form with etched bands, and handle. The drawing is completed on a beige background and is signed “Gertrude Lemberg” in the lower right corner.
title: Mug
